tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i chos skor dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi gsal byed dngos grub rab 'phel bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang rje btsun rig byed dbyer med pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dir gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa dmar po skor gsum du grags pa las/ rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i chos skor 'di la sgrub tshul gdams pa'i dbye ba las tshogs dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs pa rnams tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i 'di'i chos skor gyi dkar chag dang / phyis byon kha'u brag rdzong pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i bla mas bca' yig dang yig cha gsar rtsom rnams nas gsal ba ltar dang / de dag gi nying khu lta bu ni shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis 'di'i rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ldan las 'byung ba'i man ngag rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i bstan bcos dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba zhig mdzad 'dug kyang / yig rnying zhal mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis blo rmongs rnams nas cung zad rtogs dka' bas de'i gsal byed spyi dang / khyad par char 'bebs kyi las tshogs rnams nag 'gros bklags chog lta bu'i tshul gyis 'bri ba la skyabs gnas dam pa rnams kyis gnang ba stsal du gsol/ de yang dngos grub 'byung gnas nyid las/ dad pa dang dam tshig mchog gis rgyud mdzes shing / gzhan don la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pas 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing / lung dang rjes gnang legs par thob pa sngon du song nas bdag 'jug par byed do/ /'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum zhes gsungs nas/ dang po sngon 'gro la rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang sgrol dkar gong bsnyen/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ma sgrub pa sbyor las sgrub pa la phyi nang gsang gsum/

phyi nang gi sgrub pa la so sor ku ru kul+le dkar dmar gnyis/ las sbyor la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dngos gzhi las la'ang spyi dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ bye brag tu bshad pa la rdzas gsog pa dang las sgrub pa gnyis/ las sgrub pa la zhi rgyas dbang drag dang thun mong gi las sgrub pa gnyis las thun mong gi las sgrub pa la dngos dang / las so sor bshad pa gnyis/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrub pa'i 'bras bu chud mi za ba rnams gsung pa las/ dang po sngon 'gro nyams su len tshul gyi dbang du byas na/ gnas yid dang mthun par sgrol dkar gyi bris sku dang mchod pa dkar gtor rnams bshams nas gtan la 'dug ste/ mchod pa la a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i sogs mchod pa byin rlabs spyi 'gre bya/ sgrub thabs brgya rgyam bzhin/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor skyabs gsol bcas dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor sogs nas/ ka thugs kar hūm̐ gi bar gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud gyi bla ma rnams dang rdo rje sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la gnyis su med par thim/ dpal ldan nas/ dwangs bar gyur gyi bar gzhung bzhin/ nya rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ dmigs pa de dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas yig brgya sngags thung dang bcas pa thun rer ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar bshags sdom dang / ta lus bde stong gi nyams dang ldan par gyur gyi bar gzhung bzhin/

na tshad med bzhi sgom/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la/ lan gsum/ bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su pad zla'i steng du tāṃ yig dkar po las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig pa g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa nu ma rgyas shing lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i rgyab yol can 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bus skye 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tāṃ/ mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hūm̐/ rtsibs brgyad la tā re tut+tā re swāhā zhes pas bskor ba spro na gnas gsum byin rlabs spyi 'gre/ yang na gzhung bzhin ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ 'khor lo gsang sngags bcas bsgom tshul 'di sgrol dkar spyi 'gre lags/ spro na dbang bskur gyi phyag mtshan de 'od dpag med kyis rgyas btab/ yang na gzhung bzhin bya/ gang ltar yang thugs ka'i tāṃ las 'od 'phros zhes pa nas/ rang bzhin du gyur gyi bar brjod pa'am ma brjod kyang chog gzhung las 'byung ba'i dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i yi ge bcu pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul tshul sogs ni sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs spyi 'gre ltar la mdun gyi nam mkhar bskyed pa'i bris sku dang dbyer med du bskyed pa skabs bstun bya/ mngon rtogs ni bdag bskyed bzhin la thugs ka'i sngags 'khor med par gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs bya zhing /

mjug chog kyang spyi 'gre kho na re/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis zhag nyer gcig la yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag sogs gang 'grub bzla zhing / thun mtshams kyi bya ba gzhan dang / rtags ni gzhung bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa las/ dang po dmar mo'i phyi sgrub kyi gsham ni gzhung bzhin/ gtor ma zla gam phyag len bzhin/ ngag 'don ni mchod pa byin rlabs nas stsal du gsol gyi bar gong bzhin/ de 'on kyang sems bskyed skabs sgrol ma ku ru kul+le'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes sbyar kyang chog de nas rang skad cig gis ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros pas ku ru kul+le 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /sogs/ ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul ni/ /brtse bas rjes chags byu ru'i mdog /zla zhal rig byed phyag ldan ma/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i zhabs la 'dud/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ do maṇ+ḍal dmar po rlan dang bcas par rin po che dang 'bru sogs bkram la/ sa gzhi spos kyis sogs bstan 'gror phan bde spel ba'i phyir/ /khams gsum 'gro kun longs spyod bcas/ /bdag gi dbang du gyur nas kyang / /'phral yun dge legs kun 'grub shog /lan gsum la sogs pa ci mang phul/ cu rgyun bshags/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag nas 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur/ ce khi oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥlas ut+pal dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid ku ru kul+le dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/

che phyag dang po gnyis kyis me tog dmar po'i mda' gzhu rna drung du 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas ut+pa la'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ ju spyan gsum g.yon du g.yo ba/ 'dzum khro'i nyams can ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes shing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol zhing g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis mi ro'i gdan la gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing bzhugs pa/ khu de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i ut+pal dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs rig byed kyi phug nas ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sngon 'gros mchod/ gsol btab dbang bskur rnams spyi 'gre bzhin la/ di 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ gu dkar mo ri dwags nas/ 'khyud pa nyid kyi bar/ yi ge sngags ni nas/ tsa yod ma yin gyi bar/ ba nang mchod a mṛ tas bsang ba nas/ mtshan pa'i bar gzhung nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs bzhin la/ 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing bkol bas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya tsho dngul chu'i mdog lta bu sbrang rtsi'i ro dang ldan pa'i steng du rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems babs slar yang yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ bo lan gsum sogs/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis myangs/ ya bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin dang bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ sha bde bar gshegs pa sogs spyi 'gre'i bzlas pa bsdus/ me thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'ang byin rlabs bskyed chog sngags sogs dmigs bsal dgos pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan spyi 'gre bya zhing / 'on kyang gtor 'bul phyi mchod kyi rjes su 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang / dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ brtse bas rjes chags sogs/ rig byed lha mo 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ me ce lhag chad kha skong / brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol/ go bgo smon lam bkra shis rnams bla med spyi 'gre bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis 'bum phrag sum cu so gnyis sam/ brgyad mthar phyin par bya ba ni dmar mo'i bsnyen pa'o/ sa /de ltar bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas sgrub pa byed na gso sbyong gi sdom pa blang mchod pa byin rlabs nas bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar bya/ ha bzlas pa la 'jug pa'i tshe gzhung nas 'byung ba'i dbang sdud kyi dmigs pa le tshan gang rung lta bu la mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshigs bcad dang bcas pa brjod pa'am/ yang na dmigs pa bsgom la tshigs bcad kho na brjod/ dmigs pa de dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas yi ge brgyad pa bzla/ 'di la dmigs pa le tshan gnyis gsungs pa'i phyi ma 'di cung zad go dka' ba 'dug na'ang don la chag los gsungs pa dang khyad par med pas/ 'dir gsal byed ni chag lo rin chen chos rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i man ngag las/ yang bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis ka bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gsal bar bsgoms la/ sgrub pa po'i sa bon las 'od zer byung ba dhū ti'i lam dang snyan g.yas nas mda'i ltong la brgyud de mde'u nas bsgrub bya'i lag pa na gnas pa'i mda' mde'u la zhugs/ de'i rna ba g.yas pa nas dhū ti'i lam la zhugs te snying khar thim/

bde bas gang / spros bral bde stong gnyis su med pa la mi g.yo bar bzhag de las 'od zer tshur drangs nas/ snga ma'i lam ji lta bar brgyud de/ rang gi snying khar thim/ bsgrub bya sgrub byed kyi sems gnyis su med pa'i ye shes brtan par byas/ zhes gsungs pas dngos grub 'byung gnas su bsgrub bya'i ming dang rdo rje snying kha na gnas pa bkug ste/ zhes gsungs pa ni/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i sems la rdo rjer bshad pa 'dra zhing / ming ni 'od dang lhan cig de'i ming yig dang po yi ge'i gzugs su dgug pa 'dra'o/ ke /thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams ni gong dang 'dra zhing / bzlas pa'i grangs dang phan yon ni gzhung na gsal lo/ / 'di'i gtor ma la mdog dkar po dang zlum gtor rang zhig byas pa thad ces sa skyong bla ma bzhed/ gzhung nas rjes gnang thob nas zhes byung ba sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs nas byung ba'i lha mo dug sel ma 'di min nam dpyad/ ku ru kul+le dkar mo'i bsnyen pa ni/ mchod gtor sogs shom gong bzhin dang sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa them pa'i gang zag gis gso sbyong mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis ku ru kul+le dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥdakar mo las 'od 'phros pas ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bla ma dang yi dam la phyag gzhung bzhin dang / mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ rgyun bshags/ tshad med bzhi/ shū n+yā ta'i sngags nas bzung dug nad sel ba'i bar gzhung bzhin thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po las 'od 'phros pas ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrī las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wa ra sngon 'gros mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis rgyas 'debs pa rnams tshig rigs spyi 'gre bzhin bya/ de nas bzlas dmigs gzhung bzhin gsal btab la sngags bzla/ 'di'i skabs su dngos grub 'byung gnas las/ rang gi lte ba'i sgor nā dā la rab tu zhugs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ dkar mo'i rgya gzhung las/ de'i rjes su rang gi lte ba'i chu skyes la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du me'i sa bon la zhon pa/ sa'i mtha' dang zla ba dang thig le nā dā dang bcas shing bzhi pa'i dbyangs kyis brgyan pa/ ā li kā li 'phro ba can/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi 'od dkar po las sgron me bzhin du 'bar ba zhal gyi sgo nas thon te nor bu dang sngags sman dang thams cad yongs skad cig gis blangs nas/ lte ba'i sgor nā dā la rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lte ba nyid du pad zla la gnas pa'i hrīḥbasgom na de dang / snying khar hrīḥbasgom na lte ba'i sgor nā dā la rab tu gzhug ces pa mi thob pas/ snying kha'i hrīḥl bstim mo/ / ngam rings dpal ldan chos skyong gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rgyam gyi gsal byed las lte bar pad zla'i lteng du hrīḥ ā li dang kā lis bskor bar bsams nas zhes gsungs pa 'di rgya gzhung dang shin tu mthun no/ /sngags ni shes rab 'phel ba'i sngags dang lha mo'i snying po gnyis la grangs gzung bar bya yi/ mgo skra go cha mig mtshon cha'i sngags rnams la grangs gzung ba'i nges pa med la/ rgya bod kyi gzhung rnams la 'dir bzla dgos kyi gsal cha ma mthong yang / mgo bo sogs byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags su nges pas bzla bar 'dod na de dang de la dmigs nas gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi rjes su tshar re bton na legs 'dra zhing /

go cha zhes pa 'khor lo rna cha sogs kyi rgyan rnams so/ / sa skyong bla mas sngags ni bstan 'gyur sde dpar gyi ku ru kul+le dkar mo'i sgrub thabs 'di dang mthun pa la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le swāhā zhes pa'i bar/ thun bsdu na/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag sogs kyis 'dod gsol dang mdun gyi nam mkhar lha mo bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed la gtor ma mchod bstod 'byung po'i gtor ma bcas sgrub thabs brgya rgyam gang rung nas 'byung ba ltar dang / rjes chog kyang spyi 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa nang sgrub ni bris sku tshad ldan rnying ma'am gsar du bzhengs par 'dod na so so'i gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ de la sbyangs khrus dam tshig pa bskyed pa sogs gzhung bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i bris sku'i drung du bsham rnams gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar dang / mchod gtor rnams bsham/ gso sbyong nas bzung skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyun bshags kyi bar phyi sgrub bzhin la rigs lnga'i sdom gzung yang bya/ khe tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing rnams bris sku la bstim/ ko ye shes tshogs gsog nas bzung 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing bzhugs pa'i bar phyi sgrub bzhin la mdun du klu wa ru ṇa sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dgu dang ldan zhing smad sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas su a pa ra tsit+ta ser po g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ rgyab tu rta mgrin dmar po g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ g.yon pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yon du gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo g.yas rin po che/ g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa gar stabs can/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ di kho /gnas gsum byin rlabs nas bzung rgyas 'debs kyi bar phyi sgrub bzhin bya/

'khor rnams la rgyas 'debs kyi gsal kha ni gzhung nas ma bshad do/ /de nas dmigs pa dang ldan pas gtso bo yi ge brgyad pa 'bru gsum sogs dang / zhor la yi ge bcu pa yang ci nus bzla/ thun gyi mthar 'dod gsol dang / mdun bskyed gtor 'bul sogs ni phyi sgrub bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bris sku dang dbyer med pa'i gtso 'khor lnga bsgom pa ni khyad par dang / sgrub pa byed na mdun bskyed la rgyas btab tshar ba'i rjes su bzlas dmigs gsal btab ste sngags bzla/ de nas gtor ma dang mchod bstod rjes chog rnams ni phyi sgrub bzhin dang / ku ru kul+le dkar mo'i nang sgrub ni bris sku'i drung du mchod gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed phyi sgrub bzhin la/ bzlas dmigs dang sngags rnams gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar la yi ge brgyad pa gtso bor bzla zhing / sngags gzhan rnams ni ci nus bzla/ bdag bskyed la sngags grangs 'dzin pa bsnyen pa dang / mdun bskyed la sngags grangs 'dzin pa sgrub pa'i khyad par ro/ /thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor gzhan ni gong bzhin no/ ci /gsum pa gsang sgrub ni bris sku dang mchod gtor rnams dmar mo'i phyi sgrub bzhin dang / du skyabs sems rdzogs nas rang ku ru kul+le'i nga rgyal gyis tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ phyag mchod bya/ maṇ+ḍal ma byung kyang chog rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom gzung tshogs zhing bris sku la bstim/ co shu n+ya ta'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ chi stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du dbang phyug sngon po dang u ma dmar mo bsgyel ba'i steng rā hu la nag po rwa'i mda' gzhu can 'gyel stabs su gnas pa'i steng du hrīḥlas ut+pal dmar po zhes pa nas/ 'phro zhing bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar phyi sgrub bzhin la/ cho phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sems can thams cad kyi yid 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi dang pos ut+pal la dmar po'i sdong bu bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba/

'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che'i mda' gzhu bzung nas/ rna ba g.yas pa'i bar du 'gengs pa zhes dang / je g.yas bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis dbang phyug u ma sgra gcan dang bcas pa'i gdan la gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyogs bzhir pad nyi ro gdan la/ shar du ha las zhes pa nas sa gsum 'gugs par byed pa zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin/ te de'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phro bas skye 'gro'i yid 'chang bar mdzad pa/ rang gi snying khar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma la nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hrīḥlas ut+pal la dmar pos mtshan pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du ha dkar po/ lhor ri ser po/ nub tu ni dmar po/ byang du ha ljang khu/ de rnams las 'od zer dmar po 'phros sems can thams cad dbang du byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor lnga rta mgrin bla ma dang bcas pa gong bzhin gsal btab la/ 'ching bar mdzad pa zhes pa'i rjes su mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i dbu gtsug tu ku ru kul+le bla ma 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can/ snying kha'i gtso mo'i thugs kar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i steng hrīḥdamar po'i mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du/ oṃku ru kul+le hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis bskor ba/ 'dab ma bzhi dang phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs kar ha ri ni sa gnas gsum byin rlabs nas bzung chu lhag ma yar lud pa las zhes pa'i bar phyi sgrub bzhin la gtso mo dang rta mgrin/ pad+ma ḍāk+ki rnams la 'od dpag med ces dang / nge gzhan rnams gzhung bzhin/ bdud rtsi myangs tshar ba'i rjes su/ nu spyi bo'i rta mgrin rang ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i pang du byon yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bas rgyud gang bar bsam la mnyam par bzhag

re bzlas dmigs kyi skabs su 'od spro bsdu'ang rang dang rta mgrin zhal sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa de la byas la sngags bzla/ 'dis las sbyor gyi skabs su snying kha nas rnam shes kyi rten yi ge khrag drod rlung dwangs ma ming gi yi ge yod pa rnams blangs te gsungs pa ni/ rdo rje phur pa sogs kyi bsgral mchod kyi skabs su kun gzhi'i gnas lugs gsal 'debs de dang gcig cing ming yig yongs rdzogs sam ming yig dang po gang rung blangs pas 'thus so/ du /bzlas pa rdzogs nas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim zhes brjod/ thun mtshams kyi mchod gtor sogs 'dra ba la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gsang sgrub gtso 'khor lnga rta mgrin 'od dpag med bcas bskyed bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams byas la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pas gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod rjes chog rnams gong bzhin no/ /gsang sgrub 'di ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum gcig sgril gyi man ngag rdzas dang 'khrul 'khor sogs gang yang mi dgos pas shin tu zab bo/ /de ltar phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub them nas/ gsum pa las la sbyor ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis las sngon 'gro phal cher gzhung na gsal zhing / be 'on kyang shom gyi skabs su gtor ma zla gam de nyid ma gtogs mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma ma byung kyang chog te 'og nas 'byung ba'i las sbyor phal cher phyi sgrub la bsten pa kho na stabs bde bas so/ /'di mtshams su dbang bla mas brgyud 'debs kyang bya ba gsung / de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar phyi sgrub bzhin dang / mdun bskyed kyang phyi sgrub bzhin la rgyas 'debs tshar ba'i rjes su mchod 'bul gzhung bzhin/ 'on kyang tshigs bcad so so'i rjes su mtshan sngags sngon oṃ ku ru kul+le maṇ+ḍal la sa pa ri wa ra sogs/

'gro'i mchod sngags so so btags/ rol mo phul tshar nas/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma ci mang 'bul/ nang mchod byin rlabs byas la/ mi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang bcom ldan 'das ma gzhan yang yi dam gyi lha tshogs la 'bul tshul kyai rdor sgrub mchod sogs bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'di'i bla brgyud dang sngags brjod pa tsam mo/ /dkar mo ri dwags sogs yid mchod dang / mkhan bsod nams lhun grub kyi dkyil chog nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa'am tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa ci shes bya/ dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin byed na/ mi 'jigs phyag gi zhes pa'i tshab khams gsum sdud mdzad dbang gi lcags kyu dang zhes sbyar/ gtor ma byin rlabs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la'ang 'bul bar bshad pas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ mu la mā la gu ru sa pa ri wa ra a kā ro sogs kyis phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gis mchod/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /sogs kyis bstod pa bya/ rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlobs la brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad dbang du 'du bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yi dam bde kye sogs/ rgyun gyi kha 'don gang byed dang bcom ldan 'das ma la 'bul tshul gzhung bzhin 'on kyang zhib pa ni gong phyi sgrub kyi skabs na gsal lo/ tsi /de nas chos skyong sogs la gtor ma phul la rjes chog rnams gong bzhin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las spyi'i dang po 'khor lo la brten pa dang / gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal la brten pa gnyis ni gzhung na gsal zhing / gsum pa rdzas la brten pa ni tshar chen gyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / srin mo mdung khyer sngo sbyor 'di byas pas/ btsun bu khrab can sogs mthong snang sna tshogs kyis bsgrub bya yid myos nas dbang du bsdu ba zhig 'dra yang deng sang lag len ni med do/

/bzhi pa gzugs brnyan la brten pa dang / dbang sdud 'grol tshul yang gzhung bzhin no/ /dbang gi sbyin sreg ni tshar chen gyis gsung bzhin dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ni gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin la rgyud sde spyi khog nas kha bskangs pas mi go ba med cing / khyad par dwags paṇa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'od phreng mthong na rtogs sla yang / deng sang yig rgyun shin tu dkon no/ /las kha tshar ba rnams ni gang la gang dgos gzhung nyid na gsal zhing / dpa' bo bcu gnyis zhes pa 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi gzhung nas 'byung ba de yin zhing / ro yi mig dang snying dang zhes pa ni rims sogs kyis shi ba ma yin pa'i skyes pho mo gang rung gzhon sha can gyi ro las len pa yin te/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa don yod rdo rje dang ba ri'i 'gyur las/ mi ro'i mig dang snying dang lce/ /dpral ba dang ni de bzhin sna/ /zhib btags skar ma rgyal la ni/ /til mar btsos bkus dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bye brag tu bshad pa la rdzas gsog pa dang / las sgrub pa gnyis las dang po ni ra sug gi me tog shang shang dril bu dmar po/ gser 'od/ lug ru dmar ser/ dbang po lag pa/ snyag shar du grags me tog se 'bru/ nya 'khrig pa'i me tog me tog ser chen te lcags kyu bcu/ gzhan rnams gzhung bzhin/ dri bzang gis bris pa'i 'khor lo rnams tshang bar gsog pa'o/ /zhes pa ni/ klu sgrub kyi rgya gzhung gi 'grel pa bai ro tsa nas mdzad pa las/ rdzas gsungs tshar ba'i rjes su gzhung nas bshad pa'i 'khor lo dri bzang gis bris pa nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams dang / zhes gsungs pa la klu sgrub kyi gzhung las/ lcags kyu bcu sogs dngos grub stsol ba'i sman/ /mnyes byed dam rdzas phun sum tshogs par bsags/ /rnam lngas rim bzhin bzhi ldan maṇ+ḍal byugs/ /don rnams sgrub byed tsakra tshul bzhin bkod/ /ces dang / 'grel pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum du don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo la rtsa ba'i 'khor lo zhes gsungs pa 'dis las thams cad sgrub nus pa bzhin ril bu'i nang du 'jug rgyu'ang char 'bebs la dmigs bsal tsam ma gtogs gzhan 'di yin 'dra bas/

'bri tshul ni dpe chung dang 'khor lo'i gsal byed khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhin no/ /las sgrub pa la zhi rgyas dbang drag dang thun mong ba gnyis las/ dang po'i thog ma zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor du lha nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ stegs bu dri bzang gis byugs pa la zhi dkyil pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po pad shun dang mu khyud mdzes tshon can gyi dbus su gong rdzas la brten nas dbang sdud kyi skabs su bshad pa'i ril bu rnams rin po che'i snod du dar dkar gyi khebs bcas bzhag de'i steng mañdzi'i khar thod pa tshad ldan dri bzang gis byugs shing dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang lcags kyu bcu sogs gong du bshad pa'i sman rnams spungs che bar bzhag de'i steng du don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo rnams gan rkyal lte ba'i hrīḥmago rgyab bstan du bzhag de'i steng dar dkar la pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la hrīḥbris pas kha bub tu bkab/ lte ba'i mdun rgyab 'dab ma brgyad la ting sogs snod che chung ci rigs su lcags kyu bcu kha bkral nas bkod tshul dpe ris bzhin no/ /de'i mthar chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga mtshams 'dzin bcas g.yas bskor gtor ma zla gam ma rnams bshams la/ ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas rgyas 'debs kyi bar phyi sgrub bzhin la 'on kyang 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'o/ /ril bu a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lha mo yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ bdag mdun thun mong la mchod bstod bdud rtsi 'bul ba dang bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la thun mtshams kyi bya ba rnams phyi sgrub bzhin byas pas gzhung nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams mthong ba dang / gnyis pa rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor du khrol bu sgrub pa ni/ zhi ba'i bca' gzhi rnams bsdus la rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor ser po lte ba zlum po'i mthar gru bzhi nyis rim/

de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phyogs re la rtsibs gnyis gnyis/ de'i phyir mu khyud zlum po nyis rim/ lte bar rin po che cha dgu pa re kha gru bzhi dang phyi'i mu khyud la rin chen 'phreng ba/ de thams cad ser shas che zhing gang mdzes/ de steng rdzas 'god tshul gzhung bzhin la mañdza'i khar thod pa zhi dkyil skabs 'dab mar bkod pa'i sman rnams kyang thod par blug go /sger mchod dang / gtor ma nor gzugs ma ser po/ ngag 'don gyi rim pa mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar nang sgrub bzhin mdun gyi rdzas dang 'khor lo a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa dmar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba'i lte ba dang rtsibs brgyad la hrīḥre re/ lte ba'i hrīḥ'i mthar rgyab nas bzung g.yas bskor du/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa ya/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ sarba me pa sha la na ma hoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ rtsibs mchan la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥdzam+bhe mo hi hrīḥd ya mā ra bha ra dhe ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ mu khyud nang ma la rgyab nas bzung g.yas bskor du/ na mo rat+na tra ya ya/ na mo bud dha bo dhi satwa bh+yo/ na maḥ.aṣ+ṭa ma hā ār+ya ud kā la ya/ na maḥsab ta bh+yoḥ bhu ta ke ti bh+yo/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhrīḥsarba nā gā naṃ/ a nan ta ku lā naṃ/ tak+ṣa ka ku lā nāṃ/ shang ka ku lā nāṃ/ shaṃ ka pā ku lā nāṃ/ kar ko ṭa ku lā nāṃ/ pad+ma ku lā nāṃ/ mahā pad+ma ku lā nāṃ/ u ling ka ku lā nāṃ/ ba su ke ku lā nāṃ/ ba la ka ku lā nāṃ/ su dha rī ka ku lā nāṃ/ me gha ku lā nāṃ/ dza ma ku lā nāṃ/ dza ya dha ku lā nāṃ/ dzi mu dha ku lā nāṃ/ saṃ bar ta na ku lā nāṃ/ e ra wa te ku lā nāṃ/ ku mu ta ku lā nāṃ/ ka ta ra ku lā nāṃ/ si'u ghan dhi ku lā nāṃ/

ha na ha na pa re nāṃ/ bhan dha bhan dha/ tsa re nāṃ/ da ha ya da ha ya/ ut+pal nāṃ/ bi ta na a sha yaṃ/ dhe hi dhe hi pra la ya/ ba ka me ba dza ra ra/ a wa ta ra ya/ na ba ri shaṃ tan ta kaṃ pa she ku ru/ phu pa shi ku ru phu pa phu phu/ ku ru ba la phu phu/ ku ru ba la phu phu/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mu khyud phyi ma la ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā di mahā shra ma ṇaḥ yi ge thams cad langs zhing kha dog dmar la 'od zer 'phro ba/ ngo bo rje btsun ma la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs su gsal bar gyur/ gzungs thag nas bzung la bdag gi sku gsung thugs zhes pa nas/ sman dang rdzas rnams la thim pas zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la nus ldan du gyur zhes brjod nas yi ge bcu gcig pa ci nus bzla/ thun gyi mthar 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ gtor ma 'bul ba sogs gong bzhin byas la zhag nyer gcig tu thun gsum mam bzhir bcad nas bsgrubs pas gzhung nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams mthong ba dang / gsum pa drag po'i dkyil 'khor du dib ma sgrub pa dang dbang gi dkyil 'khor du ril bu sgrub pa ni/ rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bca' gzhi rnams bsdus la/ rang dang sgrub grogs sogs lha mo'i nga rgyal dang sngags bzla bzhin pas sman tshang ma shin tu zhib par brdung / dar sna tshogs kyi dum bu rnams kyang zhib mor byas pa bsres la thod pa dri bzang byugs pa'i nang du don kun sgrub byed kyi 'khor lo nyer gcig bris pa rnams kyang lte ba ma chag par g.yon g.yas mdun rgyab nas bltabs la g.yas nas sgril/ dar skud dmar pos bcings pa rnams bzhag la/ de'i khar sman phye thams cad spungs/ stegs kyi khar chos 'byung gru gsum kha khyer gsum rim mdog dmar shas can gyi khar rtsa ba'i ril bu dang / de'i steng mañdzi'i khar thod pa sman bcas bzhag la dar dmar pos kha bcad/

rdo rje gzungs thag kyang bzhag mchod gtor rnams zhi dkyil gyi skabs bzhin/ ngag 'don ni nang sgrub bshad ma thag pa ltar rgyas btab kyi bar bya/ de nas gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka'i zhes pa nas/ byin rlabs dang zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la/ ldan par gyur ces brjod la yi ge bcu gcig pa ci nus bzla/ thun gyi mthar mchod gtor sogs rgyas pa bzhin byas la/ thun gsum bzhi gang rung gis zhag nyer gcig sogs sgrub/ de nas dbang gi dkyil 'khor du ril bu sgrub pa ni drag po'i bca' gzhi bsdus la ril bu byed tshul gzhung bzhin/ dkyil 'khor ni mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i lte bar zla gam/ mu khyud nang ma la phyogs mtshams brgyad du lcags kyu kha phyir bstan re/ phyi'i mu khyud la pad+ma dmar shas che bas bskor/ dkyil 'khor dbus su rtsa ba'i ril bu dang / de steng mañdzi'i khar thod nang du ril bu 'khor lo can dang / 'khor lo med pa rnams spungs la dar dmar gyis kha bcad gzungs thag mi dgos zhi dkyil bzhin gyi mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar phyi sgrub bzhin bya/ ril bu dang de nang gi 'khor lo a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ril bu rnams phyi sgrub ltar bcom ldan 'das mar bskyed/ 'khor lo rnams ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i thugs kar rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub can dbu'i steng na rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa khro bo'i rgyan can gyi skur gyur/ gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams bdag bskyed byas ma thag pa ltar bya/ eḥ thugs ka'i sa bon las zhes pa nas sa phyogs zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la de khengs par gyur zhes dang / rang gi gnas bzhi zhes pa nas/ bdag gi bka' zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la nyan par gyur zhes sbyar la yi ge bcu gcig pa bzla/

thun bsdu tshul gong ma rnams sor bzhag byas la thun gsum mam bzhi zhag nyer gcig tu bsgrubs pas gzhung nas 'byung ba'i rtags rnams mthong ngo / /dwags po paṇ+ḍi ta'i dgongs pa bzhi pa drag po'i dkyil 'khor du ril bu sgrub pa ni/ gzhung na shin tu gsal bas 'bri ma dgos so/ /thun mong gi las la dngos dang so sor bshad pa las/ dang po ni/ gzhung nas gsungs pa'i bca' gzhi byas la thun bzhir phyi nang gsang sgrub dang slar yang phyi sgrub ltar bskyed nas bzlas pa bya zhing / thun bsdu tshul sogs gong ma rnams dang 'dra bar byas la zhag grangs ci rigs yi ge bcu gcig pa yi ge bcu gcig pa ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa 'dir bshad kyang yi ge bcu las ma byung bas gcig ni la nyis brtsegs la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /khri tsho sogs nus tshad bzlas la sgrib pa mthar phyin pa'i ril bu rnams tshags byed tshul ni gzhung bzhin no/ /gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la bsgrub bya myur du 'gug pa'i skabs su dngos grub 'byung gnas las rdzas gsar du bsags pa phye mar byas zhes sogs dang / rgya gzhung gi 'grel pa las/ rdzas so ma ci tshogs pa dang / gong gi ril bu tsakra mi gzhug pa rnams brdungs te zhes gsungs pas rdzas gsar pa gsog ces pa'ang lcags kyu bcu sogs rdzas rnams rang la dgos tshod bsags la ril bu'i phye ma cung zad bsre zhing dngos grub 'byung gnas su rin po che'i snod kyi ril bu nas cung zad bsre gsungs pa ni rdzas kyi dbang sdud kyi skabs su bshad pa'i rtsa ba'i ril bu phye mar byas pa'ang bsre'o/ /sgrub tshul sogs ni gzhung bzhin no/ /char dbab pa ni gzhung bzhin la/ sbrul gyi khog par 'jug rgyu'i sngags oṃ hrīḥ.a nan+ta sogs gzhung bzhin dang / oṃ hrīḥtak+ṣa ka char ya/ oṃ hrīḥshaṅka pa la char ya/ oṃ hrīḥkarko ta char ya/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma char ya/ oṃ hrīḥ.u ling ga char ya/

oṃ hrīḥb su ki char ya/ oṃ hrīḥm hā pad+ma char ya chur ya greng greng sha swāhā/ zhes bris pa bcug sbal khog tu 'jug rgyu'i phyed mtha'i 'khor lo dpe chung ltar bris zhes pa ni/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hrīḥ de'i rgyab nas g.yas bskor yig mgo phyir bstan/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥnā ga ma hā aṣ+ṭa phu la phu la swāhā/ 'dab brgyad kyi nub pad la mgo phyir bstan/ rin+ta tata/ nub byang tu mi mu ba ru/ byang du na sa ma ya/ byang shar du t+me t+me do dhi ta/ shar du la ya char ya/ shar lhor/ chur ya/ lhor greng greng sha lho nub tu rma rma ba li ye/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la hrīḥ rgyab nas yig mgo phyir bstan g.yas bskor/ oṃ wa ru ṇa sa ma ya rme rme rme ti ti ti la ya char ya chur ya greng greng sha swāhā/ zhes bris pa'i 'khor lo ril 'khor bzhin bstabs dkris byas la sbal pa brgyad kyi khog tu mgo dang mjug ma la 'khor lo'i mgo mjug gtad nas nar mor bcug rin po che'i snod du sgrub pa byas pa'i ril bu zhes pa ni gong gi ba ru ra'i tshad tsam gyi ril bu rnams mang nyung ci rigs dang / ril bu 'khor lo can gsar pa zhes pa ni 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi lte bar hrīḥ'i mthar rgyab nas g.yas bskor/ oṃ oṃ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥtsin+ta ka pa ni a dz+nyā pa ya/ nub rtsibs la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nub byang sarba/ byang nā ga byang shar rā dza/ shar wa ru ṇa/ shar lhor sa man+ta/ lho khin+ta/ lho nub hrīḥ phyi'i mu khyud la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi steng nas g.yas bskor/ bha ri sha ya bha ri sha ya sa ta ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bris pa bstab cing gong bzhin byas la lcags kyu bcu sogs sngar gyi sman rnams dang don kun sgrub pa'i ril bu'i phye ma bsres pa 'o mas sbrus nas ril bur byas pa'i khog par dbu zhabs ma log par bcug la mtshal gyi na bza' gsol/ de zhag kha shas phyi sgrub ltar lha mor bskyed nas/

bzlas gtor mchod bstod rnams bya/ gzhan go sla zhing / dkar gtor byin nas zhes pa ni/ zlum gtor a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan ci rigs/ thal mo khong stong dang / a kā ros klu rnams gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su bsngos la thal mo sbyar nas bla ma dkon mchog ces sogs nas bzung / 'di dag kyang 'bul lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin brjod la/ gtor ma chu mig tu dor ba'am gtsang sar skyel ba gang rung bya/ mchod pa byin brlab nas bzung gtor 'bul rdzogs pa'i bar phyi sgrub bzhin bya/ shom gyi skabs su bris sku'i drung mchod gtor bsham tshul phyi sgrub bzhin/ de nas char 'bebs kyi maṇ+ḍal a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa nas phuḥbacu drug zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar du mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor 'jog po dmar po/ nub tu dung skyong ser po/ byang du stobs rgyu ljang gu/ shar lhor pad+ma sngo skya/ lho nub tu rigs ldan khra bo/ nub byang du nor rgyas ser po/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po sngon po rnams g.yon phyogs su rang dang 'dra ba'i chung ma dang bcas pa ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa stod lha'i lus can sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa'i spyi bor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal pos mdzes shing / pho rnams g.yas dang / mo rnams g.yon du phyogs te thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ smad sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil ba'o/ /gzhung nas ma bshad kyang gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs kha bskangs na mi 'gal zhing legs char 'gro bas de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs kha'i hrīḥlas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mthe bong gshibs/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad/ gzhan thams cad rkyang pa gdengs ka'i phyag rgya bcas la mthe bong nang du g.yab cing gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing / /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wa ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las klu rgyal yab yum rnams la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ las sbyor sngon 'gro'i mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa bzhin la klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ mtha' yas nor rgyas la sogs klu dbang rnams zhes sogs gdon 'grol gyi gzhung nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa bya/ gtor ma gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa'i mthe chung brkyang / mthe bong bsgreng g.yas kyi thal mo de'i khar kha phub tu bzhag pa klu dga' ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phruṃ swa hā/ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha dzuṃ phruṃ phu hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes lan nyer gcig sogs kyis bsngos la/ de ltar na klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis tshim zhing mnyes nas yul phyogs 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du char chu dus su 'bebs shing /

lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig thal mo sbyar nas bla ma dang dkon mchog bcom ldan 'das ma zhes sogs gong bzhin bden bdar mdzod la klu rnams kyi thugs khar zla ba'i steng du so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i phuḥre re dang bcom ldan 'das mar gsar ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa'i sna la bzlas bya'i sngags byi ru'i phreng ba lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros klu rgyal yab yum rnams kyi thugs ka'i phuḥl g.yas su bskor/ de las 'od 'phros zhes pa nas bdag gi bsam pa bskang zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin/ yang rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥlas 'od zer gyi rtse la mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nyer mchod/ rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags/ khang bzang / skyed mos tshal/ dpag bsam gyi shing / 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo thog bza' bca' ldag myang gos rgyan longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa sogs mdor na klu rnams sdug bsngal mtha' dag las skyob cing bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa ster ba'i mchod sprin kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul ji bzhin spros nas phul bas rab tu dges shing mgu ba'i mdangs dang ldan pas char 'bebs pa'i las la gcig tu brtson zhing 'byung ba drod gsher nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs te 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lo thog 'bru bcud rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ zhes dmigs pa gsal btab la/ thog mar oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ brgya stong ci 'grub dang / de nas oṃ oṃ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥzhes sogs yi ge brgyad pa kho na thun re la ci 'grub bzla/ sngags de tsam bzla ba'i phyed tsam song ba dang yang gong bzhin klu gtor phul zhing bden pa bdar la sngags bzla/ sngags 'phro gcod pa na yang klu gtor bden bdar gong bzhin byas la/ klu'i dam tshig bskul ba'i sngags phreng 'khor tsam bzlas nas mchil ma ma 'thor bar byas la yungs dkar la phus btab ste sngags de nyid bzla bzhin pas klu'i dkyil 'khor chu mig dang bcas pa la gus 'dud kyi tshul gyis gtor/

mchod pa byin rlabs byas la mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i sogs kyis bstod/ klu'i rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le'i bka' bzhin 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char gyi rgyun phob la skye dgu thams cad dbul ba las grol bar mdzad du gsol/ yig brgya/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol/ go bgod/ bsngo smon bkra shis rnams gong bzhin byas la zhag grangs ci rigs bsgrubs pas gzhung nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams mthong zhing char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar 'dod don 'grub pa dang / grol nyin gzhan thams cad 'dra ba la gshegs gsol gyi skabs su oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyi mthar/ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes mtheb srin gyi se gol la phyir gtogs pas klu rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ lag g.yon 'og dang g.yas steng du bzhag la mthe'u chung sbrel/ mthe bong gnyis so so'i lag mthil du bkug g.yas g.yon gyi sor mo lhag ma rnams gshibs nas lag pa yongs rdzogs kha phub pa khyung gshog gi phyag rgya dang / ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes pas nag phyogs la dga' ba'i klu rnams rgyang ring du bskrad/ gnas gsum bsrung la/ sbrul gyi khog pa'i shog ril dang / sbal khog gi tsakra rnams phyung nas so so'i shul klu sman dang sbyar ba'i zan gyis bkag sngags dang 'khor lo rnams 'o mas bkrus/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi ril bu dang sngo gseb kyi ril bu phyung la dben par bsdus/ sbal sbrul mchod gtor rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcas chu mig tu bskyal nas bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /de dag gi skabs su sprin rlung gis gtor nas char mi 'bab na/ gnas de'am gzhan gang yang rung ba'i nub byang phyogs su rdza'i bum pa dri ma med pa'i nang rdo leb la dri bzang gi thig le bdun byas la tshon ljang gu'i nas 'bras gang rung gis tshom bu bdun bkod/

'jim pa la bum pa'i kha khebs pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng rdo rje rgya gram bris 'bur gang rung nyal stabs su sbyar/ rang bcom ldan 'das ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bum nang gi tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rlung lha ljang khu bdun shwa ba la zhon pa lag na rlung gi ba dan thogs pa mngon sum ltar gyur/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyiྎ chos kyiྎ dge 'dun gyiྎ bcom ldan 'das ma rig byed lha mo'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis gnod byed rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa so so'i gzugs brnyan la thim par gyur/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod/ dmigs pa ni 'jig rten khams kyi mi mthun pa'i rlung thams cad rang gi snying kha nas spros pa'i 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bus 'ub kyis bsdus nas bum nang gi rlung lha rnams la sib kyis thim par bsams la ri rab rdo rje rgya gram dang bcas pas bum pa'i kha bcad srubs thams cad 'jim pa sogs kyis bar mtshams med par bsdams pas rlung lha 'khor bcas ri rab kyi 'og tu non par bsams la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ oṃ bha yu bhe raṃ staṃ bha ya laṃ swāhā/ zhes sbrel la brgya stong la sogs pa nus tshad bzla'o/ /phyis rang gi don 'grub pa dang bum steng gi ri rab rgya gram bcas bsdus/ bum nang gi rlung lha'i rten phyir phyung la mchod gtor bsham/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi 'gre byas la/ oṃ wa ya we ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin brlab spyi 'gre dang / thal mo khong stong mtshan sngags kyi mthar a ka ro btags pas bsngos/ wa ya we sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod pas rang gnas su song bar bsam la tshom bu gtsang sar gtor/

bri thig rjes mi mngon par bkrus nas bsdu'o/ /yang sprin mi 'du ba sogs shin tu sra na rta mgrin gyis gzir ba gzhung bzhin yin kyang rang gzhan la cung zad gnod pas 'di nges par dgos na ma gtogs gya tshom du mi bya'o/ /wa ru ṇa'i nor sgrub gyi skabs su rdo'am sa las byas pa'i khang chung gru bzhi pa zhes gsungs pa ni rgya gar bai ro tsa na'i char chog gi yig sna las/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs sogs bshad pas/ gzhal yas khang chung ngu mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i blos blangs rin po che sna tshogs kyi phye ma dang / klu la mi gnod pa'i sman 'dam las grub pa'i phyogs mdog ka ba bcas/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po la dkar gsum mngar gsum rin chen phye ma bcas lhan cig tu klu gnas pa'i chu mig nas blangs pa'i chus sbrus pa'i 'jim pas klu wa ru ṇa 'og nas 'byung ba'i mngon rtogs bzhin bzhengs pa'i snying khar 'khor lo dpe chung bzhin bltab dkris gong ma rnams dang 'dra bar byas la bcug phyogs bzhir klu'i gzugs sbrul mjug g.yas 'khyil can dang / mtshams bzhir nya rta chu srin seng ge'i mgo can stod mi gzugs smad sbrul mjug g.yas 'khyil gyi snying khar phyed zla'i 'khor lo bltab bcings gong bzhin byas la bcug de thams cad la tshon rtsi legs par btang / dkyil 'khor de'i mthar rin po che dang klu sman dar zab sna tshogs spungs pa'i phyi nas dkar gsum sogs zhim khu las sbrus pa'i zlum gtor dkar po/ kha zas gtsang ma sna tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / mtshams 'dzin chu gnyis nyer mchod g.yas bskor/ sa tsa ra tsa'i spos bcas bsham/ rang nyid ku ru kul+le'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas phyi sgrub bzhin byas la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du phuḥlas klu'i rgyal po wa ru ṇa dkar po/

phyogs bzhir phyogs mdog can gyi klu bzhi/ mtshams bzhir mgo brnyan can gyi klu bzhi/ thams cad kyang stod lha'i lus can zhes sogs klu gzugs spyi 'gre bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ snying kha'i 'od kyis wa ru ṇa 'khor bcas spyan drangs la bstim/ dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis rgyas btab/ oṃ nā ga rā dza wa ru ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas chu gnyis nyer mchod rol mo/ gdengs ka nor bu sogs kyis bstod/ gzhung nas 'byung ba'i dmigs pa dang sngags bzla/ bzlas 'phro gcod pa dang klu'i rgyal po wa ru ṇa 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs 'jig rten gyi khams kyi longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsal du gsol/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs 'bul tshul rnams char 'beb bzhin la 'dod gsol bshad ma thag pa ltar bya/ yig brgya sogs rjes chog rnams phyi sgrub bzhin dang / klu'i dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya tshul de lta bus zla gcig zhag brgyad bsgrubs pas phan yon rnams gzhung bzhin no/ /'di bang mdzod kyi sbugs su gtsang sbra dang shin tu brtan par bya/ skabs skabs su mchod do/ /gnod sbyin nor sgrub kyi skabs su gzhan thams cad gzhung na gsal zhing gtor ma ni dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs kha zas bzang po du ma lhan cig tu sbrus pa'i gtor ma nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can gyi mthar sha thud bu ram sogs kha zas sna tshogs spungs/ ku ru kul+le'i bdag bskyed byas la mdun du a pa ra tsit+ta bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas a pa ra tsit+ta badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a pa ra tsit+ta ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la rig byed ma'i sngags ci nus dang / a pa ra'i sngags brgya stong la sogs bzlas pa'i mthar/

a pa ra tsit+tas bdag gi longs spyod thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs spyi 'gre byas la a pa ra'i sngags kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya btags pas phul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gros mchod/ bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po'i bka' nyan cing / /rnam thos sras kyi bang mdzod gnyer kha ba/ /dpag med gnod sbyin kun gyi gtso bo ste/ /nor bdag rin chen bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen bzang po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi 'gre/ de nas snod gtsang mar byugs pa'i me sbar la bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i khrod du a pa ra tsit+ta bskyed bstim gong bzhin byas la gtor ma nas sum gnyis dum bu dum bur gcad la a pa ra'i sngags bzla zhing brgya rtsa sogs ci nus phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin dang / 'dod gsol bzlas pa'i mjug bzhin bya/ lhag chad kha bskang / nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs sogs phyi sgrub bzhin byas la zhag gsum bdun gang rung sgrub/ kho'i tsakra dpe chung ltar bris gsungs pa 'di dpe bris sam bri yig gang rung yod 'dra yang deng sang khungs chod dka' bas rnam sras kyi be'u bum nang bzhugs a pa ra'i sgrub skor sogs nas kha bskang ngo / /mi min dbang du byas te 'byung po 'dul ba'i skabs su smyon pa sogs nad can de nyid kyi drung ngam gnas gang yang rung bar bgegs gtor chang bu ting lo sogs bcas la yi dam gang rung gi sgom bzlas kyi rjes sam thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs spyi 'gre bzhin dang / bden stobs brjod pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan la gnod byed gang yin de bkug la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis gtor ma lan grangs ci rigs bsngos la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid lha klu btsan bdud rgyal po ma mo sa bdag klu btsan the rang dam sri la sogs pa 'di zhes bya ba la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad la sbyin no/

/mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la 'di zhes bya ba'i mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod sems gdug rtsub bsam sbyor ngan pa mtha' dag zhi bar gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig zhes brjod/ gtor ma rgyang ring du bskyal/ khro bo'i sngags shes tshad bzlas pa zhag gsum sogs ci nus bya/ dngos gzhi las sbyor gyi tshe gdon gyis bzung ba'i mi de'i gam du song la ku ru kul+le'i bdag bskyed rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar bya/ bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ gzhung gi sngags rnams las gtso bor sngags ring bzla/ 'di'i rdzas kyi gras ko nye zhes pa sgog pa yin nam snyam/ thun gyis brab tshar ba'i rjes su sbyin pa'i bdag po gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'dir paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhes sogs kyai rdor bzhin thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gsal btab la rak+ṣa'i sngags brgya stong sogs brjod/ phyi rol du gong bzhin bgegs gtor btang / nang du log la bdag bskyed kyi mjug bsdu'o/ /'chi ltas rmi ngan sogs bzlog pa'i skabs su spen ril 'jag ma bong ba rnams lhan cig tu bsags pa tsho bdun gtor theb sogs su khyer la chu 'gram du phyin/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar phyi sgrub bzhin byas la gzhung nas 'byung ba'i sngags phreng 'khor gcig bzlas nas/ gong gi rdzas tsho gcig chu la bskyur la/ tshe la bar du gcod pa dang zhes sogs 'dod gsol brjod de thal mo brdab bo/ /de bzhin du rdzas tshan pa so so la sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas la chu la dor zhing dmod mo dang thal rdeb byed pa ste de ltar lan bdun byas la gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba bsngo'o/ /de ltar zla ba'am/ zhag nyer gcig gam bdun la sogs pa'i bar du 'bad pas tshe'i bar chad sogs mi mthun pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab bskyed pa'i skabs su gzhi bdag gtor ma dang srung 'khor sgom pa dkon mchog mchod 'bul sogs gsungs pa ni rgyun du kha 'don la byed bzhin pa'i gtor ma brgya rtsa sogs dang uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i srung 'khor sogs la nan tan bya zhing rten khyad par can la phyag mchod bskor ba ci 'grub bya/

dngos gzhi'i skabs su bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa rdzogs nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud srung 'khor gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ rang yang stod smad nas 'od du zhu/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ sngags phreng hriḥl thim/ hrīḥr btags khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo gi gu la thim/ gi gu yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du thim par gyur/ zhes brjod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag rang skad cig gis tha mal du gnas pa'i zhes sogs dmigs pa gzhung bzhin ngag nas brjod pa'am/ bsam pa gang rung byas la sngags ci nus bzla/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar spro na phyi sgrub bzhin nam yang na bzlas pa rdzogs nas rang bcom ldan 'das mar wal gyis bsam la gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs bya'o/ /sri'u gso ba'i skabs su bdag bskyed rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar grub nas bum pa bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las bum pa bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi zhal sogs kyai rdor gyi gnas yo byin rlabs bzhin la mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du baṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bum nang gi 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma phyi sgrub ltar bskyed/ de'i thugs khar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi nang du ma bu gnyis mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ sngags lan gcig brjod la/ bdag gi thugs kha zhes pa nas thim pas zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin la tshe dang bsod nams sogs rgyas par gyur/

oṃ ku ru nas/ phaṭa swāhā'i bar/ sum stong sogs bzlas la thun gyi mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas ma bu gnyis kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bum pa'i lha la phyi sgrub bzhin gtor ma phul la rjes chog brtan bzhugs sogs bya'o/ /de ltar zhag nyer gcig la sogs par bsgrub nas byis pa'i glud dril zan bgegs gtor rnams lhan cig tu bshams la gong smyo 'dul gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin bgegs gtor gtang ma bu gnyis la thun gyis brab gu gul bdug pa sogs bgegs bskrad spyi 'gre bzhin dang / bkru byabs bsrung gsum kyang tshe dpag med sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin la ku ru kul+le'i sngags brjod/ bsrung ba rdzogs nas bum nang gi tsakra bton la ma bu'i mgul du btags/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags dang rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i sogs bden stobs brjod la bkra shis mnga' gsol bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni gzhung bzhin no/ /zhes rje btsun sa skya pa'i zab chos rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i chos skor rnams las shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i ku ru kul+le'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa'i yi ge dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i gsal byed dngos grub rab 'phel 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rig byed lha mo'i chos skor dngos grub 'byung gnas kyi gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
